entities.summary: Yohannes Christian "Chris" John is an Indonesian former professional boxer who competed from 1998 to 2013. He held the World Boxing Association (WBA) featherweight title from 2004 to 2009, then held the from 2009 to 2013, with his near decade-long reign being the second longest in the division's history. During his reign, John defended the title against 16 boxers, the second most in featherweight history.
